Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help keep pet travel calm, safe, and well organized.

Please bring the travel details for your companion animal to the desk before departure so the team can review the journey with care. We check carrier fit, comfort needs, and handling notes in a steady, stepwise way, because every trip should support both the traveler and the animal. If a concern appears, it is reviewed with patience and passed through the proper channels without rush.

The desk works as part of a shared responsibility between travelers and staff. Clear information helps us prepare for feeding needs, rest needs, and any movement support that may be needed along the way. When something changes, let the desk know as soon as you can so the record stays accurate and the animal's travel plan stays suitable.

Aurelia Skyways thanks you for helping us protect the welfare of traveling pets and for following the guidance given at check-in. Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for any concern about your journey.
